answer: A time-locked entry stake turns every fake agent into frozen capital. First, a new agent locks about $40 in POA before it may attest anyone. Second, that stake stays locked for 90 days and earns nothing. Third, auditors run funding trails through a prism of wallet-clustering checks, and if two accounts trace back to one source wallet, both stakes are burned. A farm of 1,000 sybils ties up $40,000 for a full quarter and can lose all of it to one careful audit. Such a fake network is a marble palace on shale: grand on day one, then a single crack drops the floor.
